profile.name: US Equestrian
profile.description:
The official YouTube page of US Equestrian, the National Governing Body of Equestrian Sports in the United States.

Subscribe to the US Equestrian YouTube channel to see highlights from your favorite disciplines, horses and athletes, competition footage, educational videos and more!

reasons.text: 频道简介自称是美国马术运动国家管理机构US Equestrian的官方YouTube页面，提供各项目、马匹与运动员的赛事集锦与教育视频。
视频标题提到“Jump Off: National Horse Show Grand Prix”与“2019 Dover Saddlery/USEF Hunter Seat Medal Final Winning Ride”，属于马术运动赛事内容。
视频标题提到“Updates to US Equestrian's Guidance on Heat and Air Quality for Horse Owners”，涉及马匹护理指导。

cautions: 抽样中未出现马匹治疗师或马辅助治疗方向的视频，主题相关性主要停留在马术运动与马匹护理层面。
频道为官方机构账号，内容以赛事与会员服务为主。
这是基于公开元数据的初筛，角色为推断，尚未完成背景调研。
